title: Distinct role of claustrum and anterior cingulate cortex bidirectional circuits in methamphetamine taking and seeking.
authors: Wu, Manqing; Lai, Miaojun; Zhou, Yiyin; Cheng, Yingjie; Shi, Sai; Wang, Fangmin; Liu, Huizhen; Zhao, Min; Zhou, Wenhua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甲基苯丙胺成瘾中屏状核与前扣带回双向神经环路的作用，属于神经科学成瘾机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Methamphetamine (METH) addiction involves escalating intake with strong cue reactivity, and high relapse risk, yet its neural mechanism remains unclear. Using c-Fos mapping and machine learning, we identified the claustrum (CLA), a subcortical region reciprocally connected with the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC), as key mediators of both METH taking and seeking in self-administering male rats. Chemogenetic inhibition of CLA suppressed both drug consumption and cue-induced reinstatement, while ACC inhibition selectively reduced drug-seeking. Circuit tracing and manipulation revealed that the CLA-ACC circuit supported drug-taking, whereas the ACC-CLA circuit was specifically recruited during drug-seeking. Activity-dependent labeling showed that ACC ensembles activated by cues overlapped with those engaged during prior drug use. These findings suggest that CLA drives METH reward through the ACC, while the ACC gains cue salience and feeds back to CLA, reinforcing relapse. Targeting this bidirectional CLA-ACC circuit may provide novel therapeutic strategies for treating METH addiction.
abstract_zh: 甲基苯丙胺（METH）成瘾涉及摄入量递增、强烈的线索反应性及高复发风险，但其神经机制尚不明确。通过使用c-Fos图谱和机器学习，我们识别出屏状核（claustrum, CLA），一个与 anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) 相互连接的下皮层区域，作为自我给药雄性大鼠中METH摄取和寻求行为的关键中介。化学遗传学抑制CLA可同时抑制药物消耗和线索诱导的复吸，而抑制ACC则选择性减少药物寻求行为。神经回路追踪和操控揭示，CLA-ACC回路支持药物摄取，而ACC-CLA回路在药物寻求期间被特异性招募。活动依赖性标记显示，由线索激活的ACC神经元群体与先前药物使用期间参与的群体存在重叠。这些发现表明，CLA通过ACC驱动METH奖赏效应，而ACC获得线索显著性并反馈至CLA，从而强化复发。靶向这一双向CLA-ACC回路可能为治疗METH成瘾提供新的治疗策略。
